parole.significato: Of, or pertaining to the Davao region or Davao City in the Philippines.
parole.testo: From Cebuano Davaoeño or Dabawenyo, from Spanish davaoeño, from Davao + -eño.

parole.significato: Ground cocoa shaped into a disc; used mainly for making sikwate.
parole.testo: From Cebuano tabliya, from Spanish tablilla (“tablet”).

parole.significato: A buggy; a small lightweight carriage, usually pulled by a single horse.
parole.testo: From Cebuano tartanilya, from Spanish tartana + -illa, from Occitan tartano.
